layout_structure.title_text: OUR REMEDY: Stratified Random Sampling (SRS) module
layout_structure.layout_description: The slide follows a single-column layout with a prominent title at the top. The title consists of the phrase 'OUR REMEDY:' in blue text followed by 'Stratified Random Sampling (SRS) module' inside a pink rounded rectangular badge. A slide number '4' is located in the top-left corner. The main content begins with a bold bullet point explaining the use of self-attention. Below this is a complex technical diagram showing the flow from an input grid through a $3\times3$ stratified sampling mask, into a self-attention (SA) block, and resulting in patch-level representations. To the right of this flow is a smaller diagram illustrating the projection of sampling positions between two states, $Z$ and $Z'$. Below the main diagram, there are two indented sub-bullets. Between these sub-bullets is a qualitative visualization row featuring a color image of a parrot followed by five blue-toned attention heatmaps, captioned 'SRS ATTENTION MAP WITH QUERY AS LOCAL PATCH'. The text density is moderate, and the slide uses a clean white background with a thin vertical line on the far left margin.
